activity_summary: You looked at the dawn that was already written, down to the line of the woes. You shut it. You did not fair it, and you did not tie it, and you did not write a new line.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Shut the dawn and did not begin a fair copy.

entities.name: the lovers' dawn
entities.context: Mentioned in The dawn already written

facets.activity: Looked at the dawn already written and shut it
